安装已结束，但尚未检测到组件。请重新检测，或查看数据目录中的安装日志。: Setup has ended, but the component has not been detected. Check again or view the installation log in the data folder.
组件安装步骤已完成，检测结果已更新。: Component setup has finished and the detection results are up to date.
安装后由软件自动管理：开始映射时隐藏实体手柄，停止后恢复，无需手动配置。: Managed automatically after installation: the physical controller is hidden when mapping starts and restored when it stops. No manual setup is needed.
点击一键安装后，按 Windows 提示授权，软件会依次安装并检测所需组件。需要: Select Install required components and approve the Windows prompts. Setup installs and checks each component in turn, and lets you know if a restart is needed. You can continue later if you cancel authorization.
自动隐藏不依赖官方管理工具。此处仅供手动维护已有规则。: Automatic hiding does not depend on the official management tools. This section is only for maintaining manual rules.
未检测到手动管理工具，自动隐藏仍可正常使用。: Manual management tools were not found. They are not required for automatic hiding.
连接手柄后可查看手动规则；日常使用无需在这里选择设备。: Connect a controller to view manual rules. You do not need to select devices here for everyday use.
无法确认隐藏规则控制权: Could not confirm ownership of hiding rules
无法确认引擎的原生文件路径: Could not confirm the engine's native file path
请先停止映射或观察，再安装组件。: Stop mapping or input monitoring before installing components.
隐藏会话正在运行或恢复，请稍后重新检测。: A hiding session is running or recovering. Check again shortly.
HidHide 正被其他程序占用，请关闭官方配置工具后重试。: HidHide is in use by another program. Close its official configuration tool and try again.
Windows 拒绝访问 HidHide 驱动，请检查系统权限或修复驱动安装。: Windows denied access to the HidHide driver. Check system permissions or repair the driver installation.
HidHide 已安装但驱动尚未运行，请重启 Windows 后重新检测。: HidHide is installed but its driver is not running. Restart Windows and check again.
HidHide 已安装但控制接口不可用，请重启 Windows 后重新检测；仍异: HidHide is installed but its control interface is unavailable. Restart Windows and check again. Repair the installation if the problem persists.
未找到 HidHide 官方管理工具。自动隐藏不需要此工具；请直接启动映射，由软: The official HidHide configuration tool was not found. Automatic hiding does not require it. Start mapping to let Motion Studio manage hiding and restoration.
HidHide 管理工具缺失，请修复官方安装。: HidHide management tools are missing. Repair the official installation.
HidHide 正在使用反向应用列表，请在官方管理工具中恢复普通模式。: HidHide is using an inverted application list. Restore normal mode in its official configuration tool.
发送键盘、鼠标和所选 HID 虚拟手柄输入。: Sends keyboard, mouse, and selected HID virtual controller input.
映射时隐藏实体手柄，避免游戏收到两份输入。: Hides the physical controller while mapping to prevent duplicate input in games.
创建支持 USB 音频与高清触觉的虚拟 DualSense。: Creates a virtual DualSense with USB audio and HD haptics.
创建当前配置使用的虚拟 Xbox 360 或 DualShock 4。: Creates the virtual Xbox 360 or DualShock 4 used by this profile.
组件安装完成，需要重启 Windows: Components installed. Restart Windows to finish
开始映射前，请先准备组件: Set up components before starting mapping
重启电脑后再打开 Motion Studio，完成组件检测。: Restart your PC, then open Motion Studio to check components again.
组件检测未完成，请重新检测或查看组件设置。: The component check did not complete. Check again or open component settings.
根据当前配置检查输出和隐藏手柄所需的组件。: Checking output and controller-hiding components for the current profile.
先准备组件，再开始映射: Set up components, then start mapping
安装 Motion Studio 后，还需要为所用功能准备系统组件。下方只列出当: After installing Motion Studio, set up the system components needed for your features. Only components required by the current profile are listed below.
安装程序要求重启 Windows。请保存工作并重启电脑，再打开 Motion S: The installer requires a Windows restart. Save your work and restart your PC, then reopen Motion Studio. Restarting only the app is not enough.
已安装但尚未运行。先重启 Windows，再重新检测；仍未就绪时到组件设置中检查: Installed but not running. Restart Windows and check again. If it is still not ready, open component settings.
请到组件设置查看原因，并使用原安装工具修复。: Check component settings for details and repair it with the original installer.
此组件需要从官方项目安装。按官方说明完成后返回这里重新检测。: Install this component from its official project. Follow the instructions, then return here to check again.
当前输出方式无需额外安装组件，可以继续检查手柄输入和配置。: This output mode needs no extra components. You can continue checking controller input and your profile.
组件已就绪。连接手柄、选择配置后，可以启动映射。: Components are ready. Connect your controller and choose a profile, then start mapping.
点击安装后，按 Windows 管理员授权和安装向导完成操作。安装结束会自动重新: Select Install, then follow the Windows administrator prompt and setup wizard. Components are checked again after setup. If you cancel, you can continue later.
查看全部组件与输出设置: View all components and output settings
安装指引会按当前输出方式列出所需组件，显示安装状态，并提供安装入口。: The setup guide lists the components needed for your output mode, their status, and installation options.
确认组件、手柄和配置后，点击顶栏的「启动映射」，再进入游戏。: Check your components, controller, and profile, then select Start mapping in the top bar before entering a game.
创建支持六轴传感器直通、USB 音频与高清触觉的虚拟 DualSense。: Creates a virtual DualSense with six-axis sensor passthrough, USB audio and HD haptics.
